details.note: SetWinEventHook (out-of-context) on Notepad+calc; counts are per process family (launched exe + its children) because a launcher stub hands its windows to a child (calc.exe -> win32calc.exe); an app that failed to launch is waived with its reason, never counted as a hook failure. Cycle 26: apps are closed gracefully (taskkill without /F on the whole family, 5 s wait, /F fallback recorded) with a 5 s tail drain, to test whether the 47/1 calc gap was the kill-burst harness

each live event re-checked against Toolhelp while its process was alive; post-kill close events are shape-checked only; a close whose window was never seen open is honestly (0, unknown.exe) with a real hwnd — waived as unverifiable, never counted as verified, and only while at least one close was fully named
kill was outright (UnhookWinEvent); watchdog tick is 5 s, budget is 10 s
eye.full-titles is off by default; the tracker never calls GetWindowText while it is off; every trial-log line carries schema 1 (verified above)

defender: Defender detections before=0 after=0 (new=0) — informational only, suspended from evidence until a realtime-on scan (council condition 2)
perf_tag: runner-only — does not prove device performance
naming_frozen: app.open/app.close/app.focus (hook) vs proc.seen/proc.gone (snapshotter); no full window titles while eye.full-titles is off
honest_limits: runner has no real display; no real exclusive-fullscreen game on the runner — real-game capture is decided on the Legion; runner numbers never prove device performance
